sets: 18:4.text=Candid smartphone snapshot taken indoors in a cluttered home kitchen, slightly soft focus and uneven warm ceiling light. A man in his thirties with a short dark beard, brown skin and curly black hair, wearing a mustard beanie, a small silver hoop earring in his left ear, a wristwatch on his left wrist, and a patterned red and blue flannel shirt over a grey t-shirt. He is shown from the knees up, standing slightly turned, holding a mug in one hand, smiling at the camera. Fridge magnets, shelves and plants behind him. Realistic amateur photo, no retouching.
